Part Number: SA750T-8GOC


                                                      SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ A750 TITAN OC Edition, 8GB GDDR6, ThermalSync™, TORN
                                                      Cooling, Axial Fan, Metal Backplate, SA750T-8GOC

                                                      The SPARKLE Intel Arc A750 TITAN OC Edition are designed for players & creators who are ready to
                                                      step up to a higher tier of performance.
                                                      TITAN series equipped TORN Cooling with triple customized AXL fans, 2.5-slot design and full-metal
                                                      backplate, providing ultimate gaming experience. TITAN series also has patented(pending)
                                                      ThermalSync™, which allow users monitor their GPU temperatures at all times.
